# Shortcuts

## Profiles

Imported VPN profiles with their state. Entry point of the TUI.

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `↑ ↓ j k` | navigate |
| `Enter` | up/down |
| `d` | detail |
| `s` | accept learned scope |
| `i` | import |
| `n` | new |
| `e` | edit |
| `x` | delete |
| `?` | help (global) |
| `q` | quit (global) |
| `!` | panic-off (global) |
| `L` | logs (global) |
| `c` | copy LHOST (global) |

- Navigate, bring the tunnel up or down.
- Import, create, edit or delete a profile.

> Warning: Deleting a profile asks for confirmation.
> Warning: Bringing a profile up arms the kill switch.

## Detail

Profile detail: routes, DNS, learned scope and connection state.

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `s` | accept scope |
| `e` | edit |
| `Esc` | back |
| `?` | help (global) |
| `q` | quit (global) |
| `!` | panic-off (global) |
| `L` | logs (global) |
| `c` | copy LHOST (global) |

- Accept the learned scope to add it to the allowed routes.
- Edit the profile.

> Warning: Accepting a scope widens what the tunnel can reach: check before confirming.

## Import

Import a profile file (.ovpn or WireGuard) in three steps: path, preview, confirmation. Secrets go to the keyring, not to disk.

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Enter` | open / read / import |
| `↑ ↓` | browse |
| `tab` | complete / next |
| `shift+tab` | previous field |
| `Esc` | cancel |
| `?` | help (global) |
| `q` | quit (global) |
| `!` | panic-off (global) |
| `L` | logs (global) |
| `c` | copy LHOST (global) |

- Type the path (~ accepted, Tab completes the name) or browse the list below it: Up/Down pick an entry, Enter opens a directory or reads the file and shows the preview.
- Adjust the name and the id, then Enter on "Import".

> Warning: A rejected file shows the exact parser or daemon message, line by line, and nothing is imported.
> Warning: Secrets are never displayed.

## Edit

Form to create an OpenVPN or WireGuard profile (n), or to edit the selected profile (e): name, tags, color, scope, kill switch, DNS. The type and configuration cannot be changed: re-import the file.

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `tab` | next field |
| `shift+tab` | previous field |
| `Enter` | validate field / button |
| `ctrl+s` | save |
| `Esc` | cancel |
| `?` | help (global) |
| `q` | quit (global) |
| `!` | panic-off (global) |
| `L` | logs (global) |
| `c` | copy LHOST (global) |

- Move between fields, Enter on the button to save.
- Secrets (private key, password, sensitive PEM blocks) are masked and go through the keyring.

> Warning: Cancelling a modified form asks for confirmation.
> Warning: Disabling the kill switch leaves the scope unprotected.
> Warning: Letters typed in an input field never trigger a shortcut.

## Confirmation

Confirmation dialog before a destructive action (delete, scope). Panic-off requires typing "yes".

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `y` | yes |
| `n Esc` | no |
| `?` | help (global) |
| `q` | quit (global) |
| `!` | panic-off (global) |
| `L` | logs (global) |
| `c` | copy LHOST (global) |

- Answer yes or no.

> Warning: Press y to confirm, n or Esc to cancel.

## Kill switch

The daemon installs an nftables table `inet vpn_tui` that blocks all traffic outside the tunnel.

- **DISARMED**: No tunnel, no rule. Nothing is blocked.
- **ARMED**: Tunnel up. All traffic outside the tunnel is blocked; only the tunnel and the local link pass.
- **LOCKED**: Tunnel lost or reconnection attempts exhausted. All traffic stays blocked, including outside the tunnel, until a manual action (up or panic-off).
- **RECONNECTING**: Tunnel lost, retrying. Traffic outside the tunnel stays blocked during attempts.

panic-off removes the kill switch rules and restores normal network access; confirmation is required. Without the daemon, run as root `vpn-tuid --panic-off` or `nft delete table inet vpn_tui`.
